persona: A hands-on investor who blends fundamentals and technicals — wants companies that are financially sound AND technically set up (e.g. profitable growers that just broke out, cheap names holding their 200-day, quality stocks with an RSI reset). Naturally states one fundamental filter plus one technical condition in a single ask, often scoped by sector, country, or size.

cases.question: Find me profitable companies with revenue growing over 20% a year that just broke out above their 50-day moving average.
cases.goal: Intersect a fundamental screen (positive earnings AND revenue growth >20% YoY) with a technical event (recent bullish 50-day MA breakout).
acceptance: Every result must satisfy BOTH the fundamental leg (profitable AND revenue growth >20%) and the technical leg (recently crossed above the 50-day MA).
Growth threshold (~20%) and profitability are both applied — not just one.
The MA breakout is recent/fresh, not simply 'price is above the 50-day' at any point.
RED FLAG: returning fast growers without checking the MA breakout, or breakout names without checking growth/profitability.

cases.question: I want cheap stocks — low P/E, under 15 — that are still trading above their 200-day moving average. US large caps only.
cases.goal: Value screen (P/E < 15) intersected with a trend-confirmation technical (price above 200-day MA), scoped to US large caps.
acceptance: Every name must have P/E below ~15 AND currently sit above its 200-day MA.
Scope is honored: US listings, large-cap size band.
Both legs verified per stock, not a value list that happens to include some uptrends.
RED FLAG: presenting cheap stocks without confirming the 200-day condition, or above-200-day names that are not actually cheap.

cases.question: Show me high-margin, low-debt companies that have sold off hard recently and are now oversold — RSI below 30.
cases.goal: Quality screen (high margins AND low leverage) intersected with an oversold technical (RSI < 30 after a recent decline).
acceptance: Each result has both high margins and low debt (quality) AND an RSI reading below ~30.
The oversold condition reflects a recent pullback, not a chronically weak stock only.
Both quality metrics (margin AND debt) are considered together with the RSI leg.
RED FLAG: listing oversold stocks regardless of quality, or quality names that are not oversold.

cases.question: หาหุ้นปันผลดี ยิลด์เกิน 4% ที่ราคายังอยู่ในเทรนด์ขาขึ้น อยู่เหนือเส้นค่าเฉลี่ย 200 วัน
cases.goal: Dividend screen (yield > 4%) intersected with an uptrend technical (price above the 200-day MA).
acceptance: Every stock pays a dividend yield above ~4% AND trades above its 200-day MA.
Answer is in Thai or clearly addresses the Thai request.
Both the yield floor and the uptrend condition are checked per name.
RED FLAG: a high-yield list with no trend check, or an uptrend list with weak/no dividends.

cases.question: Give me quality tech companies in Asia — return on equity above 15% — where the stock dropped more than 25% from its 52-week high but the business is still growing revenue.
cases.goal: Multi-fundamental screen (ROE > 15% AND positive revenue growth) intersected with a technical drawdown (>25% off 52-week high), scoped to Asia tech.
acceptance: Each result has ROE >15%, still-growing revenue, AND sits >25% below its 52-week high.
Scope honored: Asia region, technology sector.
All three conditions (ROE, revenue growth, drawdown) are jointly satisfied.
RED FLAG: showing beaten-down Asian tech without confirming ROE/growth, or presenting the drawdown without verifying the business is still growing.

cases.question: I'm looking for large-cap value stocks — high free cash flow yield — that are coming out of a long volatility squeeze and starting to move up.
cases.goal: Value/cash-flow screen (high FCF yield, large cap) intersected with a technical setup (Bollinger/volatility squeeze resolving upward).
acceptance: Every name is a large cap with a high FCF yield AND shows a squeeze that is breaking out / resolving to the upside.
The squeeze leg is a real volatility-compression signal, not just any recent price move.
Both the cash-flow value leg and the squeeze leg are applied together.
RED FLAG: returning squeeze breakouts irrespective of valuation/cash flow, or cheap large caps with no squeeze.

cases.question: Find healthcare companies with over $1 billion in revenue and expanding margins that just made a bullish MACD crossover.
cases.goal: Absolute-$ and trend fundamental screen (revenue > $1B AND improving margins) intersected with a technical momentum signal (bullish MACD crossover), scoped to healthcare.
acceptance: Each result has revenue above $1B, expanding margins, AND a recent bullish MACD crossover.
Scope honored: healthcare sector.
Absolute revenue threshold and margin trend are both checked alongside the MACD event.
RED FLAG: MACD-crossover names without the revenue/margin checks, or big healthcare names without the crossover.

cases.question: หุ้นจีนตัวเล็กที่กำไรโต แต่ราคาลงมา 30% แล้ว และตอนนี้ RSI รีเซ็ตต่ำกว่า 40 มีตัวไหนบ้าง
cases.goal: Growth screen (rising earnings, small cap, China) intersected with a technical pullback (down ~30% AND RSI reset below 40).
acceptance: Each name is a China small cap with growing earnings AND is down ~30% AND has RSI below ~40.
Answer is in Thai or clearly addresses the Thai request.
Scope (China, small cap) and both technical conditions plus the earnings-growth leg are all honored.
RED FLAG: showing beaten-down Chinese small caps with no earnings-growth check, or growth names that aren't down / aren't RSI-reset.

cases.question: Which dividend growers in Europe — raising their payout and yielding over 3% — recently reclaimed their 50-day moving average after a dip?
cases.goal: Dividend-quality screen (dividend growth AND yield > 3%) intersected with a technical reclaim (price crossing back above the 50-day MA after a pullback), scoped to Europe.
acceptance: Each result is a European name with a growing dividend, yield >3%, that has recently crossed back above its 50-day MA.
Scope honored: Europe.
Both dividend conditions (growth AND yield) plus the 50-day reclaim are verified per stock.
RED FLAG: high-yield European stocks with no MA reclaim, or MA-reclaim names with flat/no dividend growth.

cases.question: I want financially strong companies — growing earnings, low debt-to-equity — that are showing bullish divergence on the daily chart. Any sector, global.
cases.goal: Financial-strength screen (earnings growth AND low debt-to-equity) intersected with a technical reversal signal (bullish RSI/price divergence), global.
acceptance: Each result has growing earnings, low debt-to-equity, AND a recent bullish divergence signal.
Both fundamental conditions (earnings growth AND leverage) are applied with the divergence leg.
Global scope is respected (not narrowed to one market without saying so).
RED FLAG: presenting divergence setups without the earnings/debt checks, or strong-balance-sheet names with no divergence.
